directive.name: vue-integration
directive.description: Rules for integrating Computer/Capability/Orchestrator architecture with Vue 3

context.principle: Vue components are thin UI wrappers - all logic lives in orchestrators
All shared state must use the createContext pattern for type-safe provide/inject
Only orchestrators use Vue reactivity (ref, shallowRef, computed)
App.vue is the composition root where all wiring happens

process.rule: Create providers using createContext for type-safe provide/inject
Place Vue refs and computed only in orchestrators, never in capabilities
Wire all dependencies in App.vue composition root

check.reason: Capabilities must be plain TypeScript - no Vue reactivity
Computers are pure functions - no Vue, no side effects

check.item: Components only call injectX() and render template
Orchestrators hold all Vue state (refs, computed)
App.vue creates and wires all dependencies

example.explanation: Capabilities must be plain TypeScript without Vue imports
Capability provides mechanism, orchestrator holds Vue state
createContext provides type safety and error handling
